description.value: Wendy's in Hope, BC is a full-service fast-food location on the Old Hope-Princeton Way corridor, a key junction for cyclists travelling the Crowsnest Highway or Hope-Princeton route. The location serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner with drive-thru and dine-in options. It is the only Wendy's in Hope and sits at a natural resupply point for cyclists heading east into the mountains or west toward the Fraser Valley.

address.value: 677 Old Hope Princeton Way, Hope, BC V0X 1L4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Wendy's location page confirms the business is open, operating at 677 Old Hope Princeton Way, Hope, BC, with phone (778) 359-0973 matching OSM. The website explicitly lists 'Wi-Fi' under 'At This Location' and OSM tags drive_through=yes and takeaway=yes, both consistent with website content. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears in either the website text or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM address uses hyphenated 'Old Hope-Princeton Way'; website and postal address use 'Old Hope Princeton Way' (no hyphen). Difference is minor but noted. Website provides fuller address including city and postal code V0X 1L4.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant at a key cycling junction in Hope, BC. Useful resupply stop for touring cyclists on the Crowsnest or Hope-Princeton routes.
